original_test_intent: Verify that the intended OS NIC interface exposes expected TX/RX activity and does not accumulate disallowed driver or physical-layer error counters during the defined observation or traffic window.
original_method: Identify the exact interface, NIC PN/serial/BDF/port, driver/firmware, link and peer; approve/install ethtool/iproute2; capture complete `ethtool -S <interface>` plus `ip -s link` at baseline; observe the approved window or generate bounded isolated traffic only if engineering retains active TX/RX coverage; capture the same full counters afterward; normalize driver-specific TX/RX/error/drop/CRC/physical fields and deltas, correlate kernel/driver logs and preserve all output without reset or truncation.
manual_activity: The network owner maps the interface/peer, approves packages and decides whether active traffic is mandatory; the agent can collect complete counters and run only the approved bounded traffic profile.
required_inputs: SUT and NIC PN/serial/BDF/netdev/physical port, driver/firmware and link/peer mapping
Supported ethtool/iproute2 versions and pinned reviewed internal Script revision
Driver-specific counter dictionary identifying TX/RX, drop, CRC, FCS, symbol, alignment and physical errors
Baseline/window and allowed absolute/delta thresholds including treatment of cumulative historical counts
Decision whether source coverage is read-only counter health or requires active TX/RX traffic
If active: isolated peer/interface, address/protocol/frame-size/rate/duration/direction and network-impact limits
safety_requirements: Do not assume eth0; prove netdev-to-NIC/port/peer identity before collection or traffic
Capture full ethtool statistics and exit status; do not head/tail away counters
Do not clear counters, reset/reconfigure the NIC, change link settings or restart the driver to obtain a clean result
Use secure credentials and verified host identity
Generate traffic only on the approved isolated path and stop on loss, link flap, congestion impact or rising severe errors
Preserve preexisting counters and report absolute values plus deltas; no automatic repair or retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify interface/NIC identity and approved tool versions
Collect complete baseline/post `ethtool -S` and `ip -s link` with timestamps and logs
If explicitly approved, run the bounded peer traffic profile and calculate packet/error deltas
Do not invent interface/peer/counter mapping or traffic requirements, truncate/reset counters, change link state or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Decide read-only versus active traffic scope and approve any profile
Review deltas/logs and issue the DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial: ip statistics can supplement source coverage and traffic can establish deltas, but `eth0`, arbitrary ping and first-40-line ethtool output are not source-equivalent or topology-safe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run complete `ethtool -S <verified-interface>` and `ip -s link show dev <verified-interface>` before/after the approved window; add only the engineer-approved isolated traffic profile and preserve every counter.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact ethtool statistics mechanism, TX/RX/physical error focus, no-error criterion, Common branch, internal Script reference and 15/5-minute estimate are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use identity-bound complete driver statistics and before/after deltas, with optional bounded traffic only under an approved profile.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable topology, counter dictionary, cumulative-delta interpretation, secure full evidence and an explicit decision boundary for active stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A ping reply or selected first counters does not prove bidirectional volume, physical-layer health or absence of errors across the full driver schema.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Counter names and reset behavior are driver/firmware-specific; passive snapshots cannot prove traffic-path performance, while active traffic can affect shared networks.

project_override_considerations: Do not import the HMC stress intent from same-code row154. The Script URL must resolve to a pinned reviewed revision that keeps row152's NIC-counter variant identity.
expected_evidence: ethtool/iproute2 versions and approved internal Script revision
Complete timestamped baseline and post-window `ethtool -S` plus `ip -s link` outputs/exits
Counter dictionary and absolute/delta matrix for TX/RX/drop/CRC/FCS/symbol/alignment/physical fields
Approved active traffic parameters/results if required, including per-direction packet/byte/loss evidence
Relevant kernel/driver logs, anomalies/escalation and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row's title, ethtool statistics command and no-error criterion coherently cover NIC TX/RX/error counters. The duplicated code is safely separated by source row and variant ID; traffic stimulus and exact counter oracle are pending scope inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Interface, tools, counters and optional peer are resolvable prerequisites; missing active-traffic inputs do not prevent the static counter review or make the variant intrinsically blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row152 variant cf57e5126db1d635 (not same-code row154): provide NIC PN/serial/BDF/netdev/physical-port/driver/firmware/peer mapping, ethtool/iproute2 and pinned Script revisions, complete driver counter dictionary and absolute/delta thresholds; decide whether acceptance is read-only counter health or includes active TX/RX, and if active define isolated peer, direction, protocol, frame size, rate, duration, loss and abort limits.

review_improvement: Preserves the full ethtool source view, separates the duplicate-code variant and replaces eth0/truncated/ping assumptions with identity-bound complete counters and an explicit traffic-scope decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: `ethtool -S` is driver-defined: a relevant CRC or physical error may appear far beyond the first 40 lines, and raw values may be cumulative since driver load. `ip -s link` aggregates a different layer and ping adds only small bidirectional IP traffic. Thus neither substitutes for complete device statistics. A valid result needs the exact interface/port identity, full before/after counter schema and a decision whether the source intends passive health or a traffic stimulus; same-code HMC row154 cannot supply any of those semantics.
